input.quote: 14. TERMINATION. Subject to Section 4 hereof, TrueLink will continue to provide the requested Hosting Services and Support Services until the last day of the month following the month in which Client provides TrueLink with a written notice of its election to terminate this Agreement.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no liquidated damages, stipulated penalties or early-termination/minimum-fee charges payable by Client. Termination (§14) requires only a written notice with service continuing to the end of the following month, and non-renewal (§13) requires 30 days' notice, with no exit payment. Section 5 obliges Client to pay only fees for services actually requested (subject to a blank minimum monthly service fee during the term, which is an ordinary committed-volume charge, not a termination penalty), and the anti-spam covenant in §7 imposes no per-message charge on Client. This meets the preferred position (no Customer-payable liquidated damages or penalties), so no redline is warranted. Note for negotiation, not as a deviation: the monthly minimums in §5a are left blank and are carved out of Client's audit and dispute rights in §6 — we should confirm those figures and remove that carve-out under the pricing/audit rules.
